5421.title: Visibility-only read tracking acknowledges unattended attention
5421.rootCauseOneLine: Read tracking uses page visibility without focus or user-input eligibility; its read request can suppress a queued notification at the sender's read-state gate.
5421.proposedFix: Model attended/shown state and acknowledge pending attention on eligible input; decide idle policy and validate native/mobile focus behavior before implementation.
5421.caveats: Two clean same-agent runs; SDK-boundary and sender tests, not native/device delivery. Historical timing and maximized-pane runtime claims unverified. Repro code is inline; reports repository forbids raw evidence artifacts. No PR: complete fix needs presence-policy decisions.
